questions.prompt: The stockbroker recommended investing some money more ____.
questions.explanation: Aggressively là trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho investing, diễn tả cách đầu tư mạnh dạn hơn.

questions.prompt: All employees are encouraged to ____ a percentage of their earnings to the retirement fund.
questions.explanation: Be encouraged to + động từ nguyên mẫu: commit a percentage nghĩa là dành một tỷ lệ thu nhập vào quỹ hưu trí.

questions.prompt: Because he had made such ____ investments, he lost very little money when the stock market went down.
questions.explanation: Conservative là tính từ bổ nghĩa investments: các khoản đầu tư thận trọng giúp giảm thiệt hại khi thị trường đi xuống.

questions.prompt: After months of study and research, the ____ decided to put his money into new facilities and materials.
questions.explanation: Investor là người thực hiện hành động quyết định đầu tư tiền; các lựa chọn còn lại không chỉ người.

questions.prompt: A good financial analyst will advise investors on strategies that will generate higher ____.
questions.explanation: Higher returns cần danh từ returns, nghĩa là lợi nhuận cao hơn do chiến lược đầu tư tạo ra.

questions.prompt: Is it ____ to consider funding a new project when we haven't even seen the returns from the last one?
questions.explanation: Is it wise to... cần tính từ wise sau be: liệu tài trợ dự án mới đã là quyết định sáng suốt chưa.

readingPassage:
Many people try to save money by acting as their own investment advisors. This is not usually considered to be a
wise choice. In the long term, it can actually end up costing the investor more money because of poor investment
decisions. A professional investment advisor understands investment options more thoroughly than the layperson
ever could. A good investment advisor becomes familiar with her clients' [16] ____ toward investing and gives advice
accordingly. The advisor makes certain recommendations to clients who are conservative investors and makes
different recommendations to clients who prefer to invest more [17] ____. The best way to create a strong investment
[18] ____ that matches your needs and preferred investing strategy is to work with a professional investment advisor.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (16).
questions.explanation: Attitudes toward investing là thái độ đối với đầu tư; phần sau phân biệt khách thận trọng và khách mạnh dạn.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (17).
questions.explanation: Aggressively là trạng từ chỉ cách invest, đối lập với nhóm conservative investors trong câu trước.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (18).
questions.explanation: Investment portfolio là danh mục đầu tư, gồm các khoản đầu tư phù hợp nhu cầu và chiến lược của khách hàng.

readingPassage:
To:
Amelia Waddell
From:
Peter Simpkins
Subject: Investment
Hi Amelia,
I wondered if you would give me the name of your
investment advisor. My business is doing very well this
year. In fact, I am now making a lot more money than
I did when I had a job with a salary. I would prefer to
invest my profits in the stock market as I'm sure I
would earn more money that way than just letting it
earn interest in a bank account. Of course, I want to
invest wisely, so I am looking for professional advice.
You know I tend to have a conservative attitude
toward money, and I hope your advisor can help me
make some safe investments. Please get back to me
soon as I'd like to get started on this before the end of
the month. Thanks.
Peter
To:
Peter Simpkins
From:
Amelia Waddell
Subject: Re: Investment
Hi Peter,
I would be happy to help you out. As a matter of fact,
I just talked with my investment advisor this morning,
and she mentioned that she is looking for more
clients. Her name is Susannah Oliveros. I have been
working with her for several years and have always
been satisfied. I have gotten good returns on the
investments I have made with her. I will call you this
afternoon, and we can discuss all the details then. I
will also give you her phone number so you can call
her tomorrow. I know you will like her.
Amelia

questions.prompt: Why did Peter write the e-mail message?

choiceTexts.A: He is looking for a job.
choiceTexts.C: He lent some money to Amelia.
choiceTexts.D: He is looking for new clients.

questions.explanation: Peter xin tên cố vấn vì muốn được hướng dẫn đầu tư một cách sáng suốt, nên mục đích là cần lời khuyên đầu tư.

questions.prompt: Why does Peter have extra money to invest?

choiceTexts.A: He earned a lot of interest in his bank account.
choiceTexts.D: He made money in the stock market last year.

questions.explanation: Peter nói doanh nghiệp đang hoạt động rất tốt và kiếm nhiều hơn công việc hưởng lương trước đây; tiền đầu tư đến từ lợi nhuận kinh doanh.

choiceTexts.D: Before the end of the month.

questions.explanation: Amelia viết I will call you this afternoon; tomorrow là thời điểm Peter có thể gọi cố vấn.

questions.prompt: The word wisely is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Wisely nghĩa là một cách sáng suốt, gần nghĩa smartly; carefully chỉ nhấn mạnh sự cẩn thận.

questions.prompt: The word returns is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Good returns on investments là lợi nhuận tốt từ đầu tư, tương ứng profits chứ không phải hành động quay lại.
